description: Source code for AAC audio extractor implementation in Android, including classes for handling AAC streams, parsing ADTS headers, and integrating with media extraction framework.

classes.name: AACSource
classes.description: Represents an AAC media track, providing methods to start, stop, get format, and read frames.

classes.name: AACExtractor
classes.description: Main class for extracting AAC audio streams, managing track count, metadata, and creating AACSource instances.

methods.name: get_sample_rate
methods.description: Returns the sample rate based on the sampling frequency index.

methods.name: getAdtsFrameLength
methods.description: Parses ADTS header at given offset to determine AAC frame length and header size.

methods.name: AACExtractor::AACExtractor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes extractor by reading AAC stream headers and metadata.

methods.name: AACExtractor::getMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about the AAC stream.

methods.name: AACExtractor::countTracks
methods.description: Returns the number of tracks (1 if initialized successfully).

methods.name: AACExtractor::getTrack
methods.description: Returns a new AACSource for track 0 if available.

methods.name: AACExtractor::getTrackMetaData
methods.description: Copies track metadata into provided format.

methods.name: AACSource::start
methods.description: Starts the AAC track, preparing buffers.

methods.name: AACSource::getFormat
methods.description: Returns the format of the AAC track.

methods.name: AACSource::read
methods.description: Reads the next AAC frame, handling seeking and buffer management.
